topic: Regulatory capacity ceiling vs. allocated capacity
wiki_text: Italy's authorities approved an expansion of Adriatic LNG's regulatory regasification ceiling to 10.4 bcm/y (Montel, reporting the government approval), but the capacity actually allocated/marketed by the terminal as of early 2026 remains 9.5 bcm/y combined (9.0 main + 0.5 Capacity Expansion unit, per LNG Industry, Feb 2026). GEM's Capacity fields record the allocated figures, not the regulatory ceiling.

topic: Vado Ligure relocation proposal formally cancelled
wiki_text: A 2026 proposal to relocate the Piombino FSRU offshore of Vado Ligure by 2026 (reported by Investing.com/Reuters-sourced Italian press) was formally CANCELLED by an Italian decree-law dated 11 March 2026 (Il Post). Piombino FSRU continues permanent operation at its current site under its Snam-owned SPV 'FSRU Italia' / vessel Italis LNG (ex-Golar Tundra).
